'''Iridia''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colony-[[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It was the home of [[Donloor Noth|Donloor]] and [[Oorn Noth]].<ref name="Oorn Noth: Racer on the Run">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/BP1Oorn|series=Bounty Postings|text=1: Oorn Noth: Racer on the Run}}</ref>
